syscalls.comment: RootlessKit: CLONE_NEWUSER | CLONE_NEWNS; mask namespace bits so Go process flags remain allowed without permitting other namespaces.
BuildKit/runc with host networking and no process sandbox: CLONE_NEWNS | CLONE_NEWUTS | CLONE_NEWIPC.
BuildKit/runc on cgroup v2 adds CLONE_NEWCGROUP to the mount, UTS, and IPC namespaces.
runc mount-source thread detaches shared filesystem state with CLONE_FS before setns.
runc mount-source thread enters only a mount namespace (CLONE_NEWNS); kernel capability checks still apply.
BuildKit/runc mount setup and hostname in private namespaces; kernel capability checks still apply.
Keep keyrings unavailable: runc tolerates ENOSYS, but its default session-keyring setup fails on EPERM.
